newsitem.title: USA: Wellspring buys major stake in ice hockey company.
newsitem.headline: Wellspring buys major stake in ice hockey company.

text.p: Wellspring Associates L.L.C. said Friday it will acquire a majority stake in SLM International Inc., a leading manufacturer and marketer of ice and roller hockey equipment, primarily under the CCM brand name.
The acquisition follows the confirmation late Thursday of SLM's Chapter 11 plan of reorganization. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

"SLM International is an outstanding acquisition for Wellspring. Its CCM brand is the most widely-recognised name in hockey equipment. Ice and roller hockey are two of the fastest growing sports in North America," Greg Feldman, a managing partner of Wellspring Associates, said.
The SLM transaction is Wellspring's second acquisition. In October 1995, Wellspring acquired Lionel, the world's leading manufacturer and marketer of model electric trains.
Wellspring Associates is a privately-held investment firm founded by financiers Martin Davis and Greg Feldman.
